sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
action(['SPACE','UP'])
def pos(fr):
    B=[]; D=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='B' and 20<n['pixels']<100: B.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
        if n['color'] in 'SW' and n['pixels']>30: D.append((min(rows),max(rows)))
    return B, D
B,D = pos(current_frame)
print('B:', B); print('div:', D[:1])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
